name: Tommy Paul
intro: Tommy Paul is a speedy American from North Carolina. Fans call him TP. He chases down every ball.
story: Tommy grew up on clay courts in Greenville, North Carolina. As a junior he won the French Open boys' title. He beat his pal Taylor Fritz in that final. In 2024 they won an Olympic bronze medal together in doubles. On Friday he was down two sets to one, then came back to win.

funFacts.text: He loves deep-sea fishing. He says it clears his mind.
As a kid he fished every summer weekend in North Carolina.
He wears camo clothes a lot. He calls himself an outdoor guy.
His other hobbies are surfing, basketball, golf, and dirt bikes.
He is a big Philadelphia Eagles football fan.
His favorite tournament is the US Open.
He has beaten Carlos Alcaraz twice, and Rafael Nadal too.

watchFor: Watch him spin his racket on his fingers between points, like a toy.
